title: Ruh Sandığı — Soul Chest
description: Die in peace: your items and XP sleep safely in an unbreakable soul chest at your death spot. Right-click to get everything back in its exact slots — armor re-equips itself. Available in 8 languages.
body:
# Ruh Sandığı — Soul Chest 👻

**Die in peace.** When you die, your items and XP don't scatter into lava, the void, or a creeper
crater — they fall asleep inside a **soul chest** at your death spot. Only you can open it, it never
despawns, and its sleeping soul face glows with soul fire so you can find it in the dark. And if
your chest is too far to walk back to? Craft a **Soul Beacon** and summon it to you.

## ✨ Features

- 👻 **Soul chest on death** — your whole inventory is tucked into an unbreakable chest exactly
  where you died, with smart placement: on water it stays put, deep lava pushes it to the surface,
  and void / boxed-in deaths send it safely to your **spawn** so nothing is ever lost
- 🎒 **Perfect restore** — right-click your chest and everything returns to its **exact slots**:
  armor equips itself, your hotbar layout is untouched, overflow drops at your feet
- 💫 **XP is saved too** — no more watching 30 levels evaporate; your experience sleeps in the
  chest and returns with your items
- 🔦 **Soul Beacon (ritual item)** — craft a beacon to **summon a distant chest to you**:
  - Only one chest? Just **hold right-click** — it channels with a soul-flame vortex and teleports in.
  - Multiple chests? **Shift + right-click** opens a radial menu showing each chest's location and a
    **preview of the items inside**, so you pick the right one. Then hold right-click to summon it.
  - Costs **4 hearts** ("a piece of your soul") and has a 10-second cooldown.
- 👥 **Transfer to another player** — Shift + right-click your chest with an empty hand to open a
  radial player menu; pick a friend and the chest (and its contents) becomes theirs
- 🔒 **Owner-locked** — only you can open your chest; nobody can break it, blow it up or push it
- 😴 **Sleeping soul** — the chest has a face: closed eyes, a little "Z", drifting soul-fire particles
- 💬 **Death message** with coordinates + dimension
- 🏆 **Advancements** — *Soul Keeper*, *Reunion*, *Soul Summoner*, *Soul Friend*
- ⚙ **Configurable** — `config/ruhsandigi.json`: owner-only lock, XP saving, death message
- ✅ **Plays fair** — respects `keepInventory`, honors Curse of Vanishing, works in every dimension
- 🌍 **8 languages** — English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Español, Français, Русский, Português (BR), 简体中文

## 🔦 Soul Beacon recipe

```
Iron    Iron        Iron
Ender   Soul Lantern Ender
Iron    Soul Sand    Iron
```

## 🎮 How it works

1. **Die** anywhere — a soul chest appears (or falls back to spawn if the spot is unsafe).
2. **Walk back** using the chat coordinates and right-click it — armor equips, hotbar restores, XP returns.
3. **Too far?** Craft a Soul Beacon. Hold right-click to summon your only chest, or Shift+right-click
   to pick one from the radial menu (with item previews). It teleports to you for 4 hearts.
4. **Sharing?** Shift + right-click a chest with an empty hand to hand it to another player.

## 🔧 Requirements

- Minecraft **26.1.2** · **Fabric Loader** 0.19.3+ · **Fabric API** · Java 25
- Works in singleplayer and on servers (transfer needs multiplayer)

---

# 🇹🇷 Ruh Sandığı

**Huzur içinde öl.** Ölünce eşyaların ve XP'n lava, boşluğa ya da creeper çukuruna saçılmaz —
ölüm noktanda beliren **ruh sandığında** uykuya dalar. Sadece sen açabilirsin, asla kaybolmaz,
uyuyan ruh yüzü karanlıkta parlar. Sandığın çok uzakta mı kaldı? Bir **Ruh Feneri** yap ve yanına çağır.

- 👻 Ölümde tüm envanter kırılamaz sandığa girer — akıllı yerleşim: suda yerinde, derin lavda yüzeye,
  boşluk/kapalı ölümlerde **doğuş noktasına** kurtarılır (eşya asla kaybolmaz)
- 🎒 Sağ tık = **birebir slot düzeniyle** geri alma: zırh giyilir, hotbar aynı kalır
- 💫 **XP de saklanır** — seviyelerin buharlaşmaz, sandıkla geri gelir
- 🔦 **Ruh Feneri (ritüel eşyası)** — uzaktaki sandığı yanına çağır:
  - Tek sandık varsa: sadece **sağ tık basılı tut** — ruh alevi girdabıyla kanalize olup ışınlanır.
  - Çok sandık varsa: **Shift + sağ tık** ile radyal menü açılır (konum + **içindeki eşyaların
    önizlemesi**), seç, sonra sağ tık tutup çağır.
  - Bedel **4 kalp** ("ruhundan bir parça") + 10 saniye bekleme.
- 👥 **Başka oyuncuya devret** — sandığa boş elle Shift + sağ tık → oyuncu menüsü → sandık ona geçer
- 🔒 Sadece sahibi açabilir; kırılamaz, patlamaz, itilemez
- 😴 Uyuyan ruh yüzü + ruh ateşi parçacıkları
- 💬 Sohbete koordinat + boyut mesajı · 🏆 4 başarım · ⚙ config · ✅ keepInventory & Kaybolma Laneti'ne saygılı
- 🌍 8 dil desteği — tam Türkçe

**Ruh Feneri tarifi:** demir çerçeve + 2 ender incisi + ruh feneri (orta) + ruh kumu (alt orta). İyi ölümler! ⚰️✨
